Card Q&A.a: No, only cards specifically named [Garurumon] meet the condition for this card's effect. The effect won't activate with card names such as [Garurumon (X Antibody)] that don't match, even if the name includes [Garurumon].
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's effect activate even if it has [Garurumon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card?

Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has a [Garurumon] digivolution card, unsuspend this Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While you have 8 or more cards in your hand, this Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
